newsitem.title: GERMANY: Didier-Werke Q1 loss 8.8 mln dmk vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Didier-Werke Q1 loss 8.8 mln dmk vs profit.

text.p: NOTE - Full name of the German manufacturer of blast furnace linings is Didier-Werke AG, a subsidiary of Austria's Radex-Heraklith.

Didier said earnings in in its fire resistant materials division were hit by one-off rrestructuring costs at U.S. subsidiary NARCO and because production at its German and west European plants was affected by a "difficult" development of orders up to the final quarter of 1996.
In addition, the fire resistant materials division is traditionally weak in the the first quarter of the year, Didier said in a mandatory statement.
Also, Didier's plant division was hit by the weakness of the construction sector.

The energy and high temperature division traditionally sees a boost during the second half of the year when revenue from large plant products is booked, the statement said. Planned restructuring measures in that division did not have an effect on earnings in the first quarter, it added.
